Method of Attack: Exploits a flaw in Black Basta ransomware encryption algorithm allowing recovery of files by extracting the reused 64-byte keystream used for XOR encryption
Reusing the same keystream during encryption causes zero-byte chunks to reveal the encryption key
Decryptor uses known plaintext attack on 64 encrypted bytes to recover keystream and decrypt files
Impacted Systems: Files encrypted by Black Basta ransomware versions from November 2022 to about a week before June 2023
Virtual machine disks and large files containing zero-byte chunks
Attack Vector: Black Basta ransomware encryptor exploiting XChaCha20 stream cipher keystream reuse vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files with random extensions (not .basta) from Black Basta ransomware versions Nov 2022 to June 2023
Presence of 64-byte zero-byte chunks in encrypted files revealing keystream
